subject: financial_literacy
concept: Understanding that investing involves risk, and that historically the stock market grows over the long term despite short-term ups and downs
source_inspiration: original content — not sourced from any external text

exercise.concrete: Student traces a simplified long-term market chart showing short-term dips within an overall upward trend
exercise.pictorial: Student matches a short-term drop to the long-term trend it sits within
exercise.abstract: Student explains why a long-term investing approach can make sense even though the market goes up and down in the short term

misconception_flags: reacts to a single short-term drop as if it means long-term investing has failed

interest_binding: exercise regenerated using student's stated interest profile
